title: HDS clientData.hdsExtraction
description: Which program read the value from a document, with which knowledge base and backend, and the role of who confirmed it. Ids and versions only: no document text, no prompt or model output, no name or account id. See documentation/PROVENANCE.md.

engine.description: Stable id of the reading program, lowercase (hds-reader); the <tool> of the sourceKey it writes.

engineVersion.description: The program's version, semver MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH with an optional pre-release.

kbVersion.description: The version of the knowledge-base pack the program used, semver MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH.

backend.description: Opaque id of the program's backend configuration record that read the printed line, never parsed (for example <runtime>:<model>, or text-layer when no backend ran). No spaces; never a URL, a host name, a device name or a user name.

confirmedBy.description: The role of who confirmed the value before it was written: person (the account holder, from her own app). Never a name or an account id.

corrected.description: true when the person changed the value, the item or the unit before it was written. Absent otherwise.
